name: Lateral Band Walk
definition: Resisted lateral stepping with a loop immediately above the ankles, a self-selected squat posture, and approximately thirty-centimeter initial foot spacing and lead steps. A repetition consists of a leading step followed by a trailing step restoring that gap; repeat equally in the opposite direction. The lead hip abducts against the loop and the trailing hip adducts under band tension with eccentric abductor control. Berry directly recorded gluteus medius, gluteus maximus and TFL in moving and stance limbs; primary gluteus medius and secondary TFL are categorical emphasis judgments, not EMG rankings. Gluteus maximus, vasti, abs, obliques and soleus receive conservative postural control roles for the maintained squat, trunk and stance. No deliberate hip rotation or concentric adductor role is inferred. Upright walking, unreviewed band placements around the feet, diagonal monster walks, crossover steps, squatting on every step, and unsupported open-chain abduction remain outside this family. Isolation describes the defining resisted hip motion; the held squat and foot-clearance adjustments are nondefining. Both moving and stance hip abductors contribute as support shifts and the pelvis travels. The Boxing Science above-knee fixture begins at hip-width with slight hip and knee flexion, steps laterally against a mini band just above the knees, and returns the trailing foot to the starting spacing. Its shorter band lever arm is not interchangeable with the ankle-band fixture.

execution.startingPosition: Place a loop band just above your ankles. Point your feet forward about 30 cm apart and settle into a comfortable squat.
execution.movement: Step one foot about 30 cm sideways while keeping the same squat depth.
execution.endpoint: Plant the leading foot with the band stretched and your trunk controlled.
execution.returnPhase: Step the trailing foot slowly toward the leading foot until the original gap between your feet is restored. Count that complete step pair as one repetition.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep your knees aligned with your feet and avoid bouncing up and down or swaying your trunk.
execution.supportAndPosture: Shift support from one leg to the other while keeping tension in the band and maintaining your squat.
disqualifyingCompensations: Stepping diagonally changes the lateral walk into a monster walk.
Standing up between steps changes the maintained-squat fixture.
Moving the band above the knees or around the feet changes its resistance geometry.
execution.sideOrDirection: Complete the logged repetitions in one direction, then repeat the same number in the opposite direction.

execution.startingPosition: Stand with feet hip-width apart and a mini band just above both knees. Bend the hips and knees slightly.
execution.movement: Push the knees outward against the band, step one foot to the side, then step the trailing foot toward the lead foot to restore hip-width spacing.
execution.endpoint: Finish each paired step with both feet planted at approximately the starting width.
execution.returnPhase: Continue in the same direction for the prescribed repetitions, then reverse direction.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the knees tracking with the feet and maintain slight hip and knee flexion.
execution.supportAndPosture: Stay upright and keep tension in the band without twisting the pelvis.
disqualifyingCompensations: Moving the band to the ankles changes the reviewed resistance lever arm.
Letting the feet snap together removes band tension between steps.
execution.sideOrDirection: Complete the same number of paired side steps in each direction.
